number_of_samples: This study comprised two patient cohorts: the first encompassed a pool of saliva samples from five patients with lymph node metastasis (pN+; “p” indicates the presence of metastasis in the lymph node histologically confirmed) and without lymph node metastasis (pN0) for protocol optimization, and an independent patient cohort including healthy control (n = 4) and OSCC patients (n = 8, pN0 = 4, pN+ = 4).
technology_type: For this, we employed limited proteolysis–mass spectrometry in saliva samples to explore structural alterations, comparing the proteome of healthy control and oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) patients with and without lymph node metastasis.
